children: The UAE's biggest lender First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) has raised $500 million from a benchmark five-year senior unsecured bond after attracting more than $1 billion of orders, excluding joint lead manager interest.
The UAE lender priced the Reg S issue at US Treasuries plus 90 basis points. Initial price thoughts (IPTs) were in the T+115bp area. The notes carry a 5.456% coupon and were issued at par.
FAB is rated Aa3 by Moody’s, AA- by S&P and AA- by Fitch.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: UAE’s FAB prices $500mln 5-year bond amid strong investor demand
